About Odin

Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets.
We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should be putting it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in.

Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legals and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits.

We’re already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $500m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors.

Why We're Hiring

We're hiring across product, design, engineering, growth, legal and operations - and our US launch will add New York hiring on top of that. Hiring the right people is central to our success to not have someone focused on it entirely.

You'll find exceptional people, but you won't just be the person holding everyone to a bar - you'll work with the founders and leadership team to shape what that bar actually looks like.

This isn't a role where you speak to candidates and move them through a process. You'll understand the product, business and teams deeply enough to assess people properly, challenge hiring managers when needed, and hold the business to the same standard we expect from candidates.

And because you'll often be the first person someone meets from Odin, you'll need to give exceptional people a reason to care about a company many of them haven't heard of yet.

Employer brand is a core part of the role, not something you get to once hiring goes quiet. You'll help build the content, events and community engine that puts Odin in front of the best operators in tech before they're looking for their next job - and makes hiring easier over time.

Responsibilities

  • Run hiring end to end across senior and business-critical roles, from role scoping through to start date.

  • Own pipeline. The people we most want to hire often aren't applying, so outbound, market mapping, network building and getting others involved in referrals are a core part of the week.

  • Run hiring kick-offs that create real clarity around what the role is, what great looks like, and how we're going to assess it.

  • Design interview processes that test reasoning, behaviours and capability rather than rehearsed answers, using challenges, scorecards and structured assessments where appropriate.

  • Own candidate communication end to end, with the same level of care whether someone is progressing or not.

  • Keep employer brand top of mind and be hands-on in shaping it. Whether through content, events or community, you'll find ways to put Odin in front of the right people before they're looking for a job.

  • Use AI as part of how you operate across sourcing, research, screening, candidate experience, operations and employer branding.

  • Use hiring data to change decisions, prioritise roles and coach managers — not simply to report on the funnel.

  • Continuously improve how we use Ashby, our hiring documentation and the quality of our interviews.

  • Give clear, well-reasoned hiring recommendations with limited oversight, including when your view isn't what a hiring manager wants to hear.

Who You Are

  • An experienced recruiter with an unusually high bar for quality and strong judgement across functions. You notice patterns, inconsistencies and signals others can miss, and assess reasoning, behaviours, capability and values rather than relying on experience on paper.

  • Brilliant at asking questions and getting underneath people's reasoning. You surface the questions others are thinking but haven't said out loud, interrogate incomplete briefs, and keep digging until there's real clarity.

  • Comfortable bringing an original point of view rather than simply playing back what's already been said. You'll challenge founders and hiring managers when needed, and do it constructively.

  • Deeply care about candidate experience, even when things are moving quickly, and hold the same bar whether someone is progressing or not.

  • Operationally tight: you spot blockers early, keep processes moving and improve the system while using it.

  • You've used AI in a meaningful way to improve how you hire and can give clear examples of what changed as a result.

Bonus if you have

  • Experience as a first or early Talent hire, where you've had to build structure from scratch.

  • Experience building employer brand or talent marketing that materially changed who engaged with or applied to a company.

  • Experience using hiring funnel or market data to influence decisions, prioritise roles or coach hiring managers.

This role is probably not for you if...

  • You need a lot of structure before you can make progress. There's plenty here still to build, and you'll need to be comfortable creating clarity rather than waiting for it.

  • You avoid making decisions when the context is incomplete. We need someone who can gather the right information, form a view and make high-quality calls without escalating every grey area.

  • You find it difficult to challenge senior stakeholders. You'll need to push back constructively, challenge assumptions and drive clarity with people across the business.

  • You don't enjoy outbound. Proactive pipeline building is a significant part of this role; relying predominantly on inbound won't work here.

  • You tend to take briefs at face value. We want someone who reads between the lines, asks what's missing and brings their own point of view rather than simply executing what they're given.

Bottom line

This isn't about whether you've done 360 hiring before - it's about how you approach it.

We're not looking for someone to simply execute a hiring process. We're looking for a Talent partner who thinks deeply about the role hiring plays in the business, asks excellent questions, brings their own judgement and isn't afraid to challenge when needed.

You'll often be the first person a candidate meets, and you'll have a meaningful influence on how our managers think about hiring.

You're not just moving people through a process. You're helping us decide what great looks like, finding those people, shaping their experience of Odin and raising the quality of how we hire as we grow.

Salary

£70,000–£80,000 + equity options

Working at Odin

We're a London-based team, and this is a role where working closely with the founders and wider team in person makes a real difference.

We move quickly, hiring priorities evolve, and many of the best conversations happen by being close to the teams you're hiring for. We therefore expect this person to be in our London office at least three days per week.

Benefits

  • Health: Private health insurance (Vitality), paid sick leave including support for pregnancy loss and fertility treatments, and access to Spill for mental health support

  • Wellness: £1,000 annual budget for health, therapy or fitness

  • Parental Leave: Enhanced maternity, adoption, paternity and partner leave

  • Pension: 4% employer contribution with salary sacrifice options

  • Time Off: 25 days annual leave, 2 wellness days and flexible bank holidays (33 days total)

  • Work From Anywhere: Up to 6 weeks per year working from anywhere globally

  • Birthday Leave: An additional day of leave

Compensation: £70K – £80K • Offers Equity

data.description:
ABOUT FLOCK

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

THE ROLE 

Our brokers play a crucial role in making this a reality. We’re an AI-first business, so whatever the role, we want people who reach for AI by default, stay curious about what it can do, and use it to work faster and think bigger. You’ll use AI day to day, from researching brokers to preparing for meetings, so more of your time goes on the conversations that win business. We’re looking for an ambitious and passionate Broker Development Manager to accelerate our distribution through brokers. In this role, you’ll maximise existing broker relationships and build strong, strategic, growth partnerships as part of our fast-paced distribution team right at the heart of Flock’s mission.

WHAT WE THINK IS MOST EXCITING ABOUT THE ROLE:

Be a part of building something truly game changing in the fleet market. You’ll manage a panel of key strategic brokers with significant growth opportunities. You’ll engage them on the market-leading benefits of Flock’s connected fleet proposition, and how together, we can reduce risk, improve costs and save lives. You’ll also have real freedom in how you use AI to work, whether that’s getting under the skin of a broker’s book before a meeting or spotting growth opportunities across your panel.

A LITTLE MORE ON WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

  • Act as a primary face of Flock for a panel of key broker partners, driving mutual growth and long-term success.

  • Deliver high volumes of broker submissions, directly supporting Flock’s ambitious growth targets.

  • Build, grow and develop our broker panel, onboarding new partners at pace and maximising their commercial potential.

  • Proactively engage brokers, finding new and creative ways to promote Flock’s appetite and proposition as we expand into new sectors.

  • Develop and execute clear, data-driven account growth strategies to drive sustained performance.

  • Achieve strong conversion and retention by supporting day-to-day trading activity and helping brokers (and Flock) win and retain business.

  • Work closely with internal teams, collaborating with brilliant Flockers across the business to deliver shared growth objectives.

  • Maintain strong broker advocacy by being visible, responsive and passionate about Flock’s product, proposition and mission.

  • Use AI in your day-to-day work, from broker research and meeting prep to analysing your pipeline, so your time goes on relationships rather than admin.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO FLOCK:

ESSENTIAL

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in managing broker relationships within the insurance sector, possessing a reputable standing in the industry.

  • Energy and innovation in abundance - the ability to work fast, spot opportunity and solve problems. 

  • A proven track record of exceeding revenue targets, driving business growth, and closely collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve collective objectives.

  • An existing network of broker contacts that will enable a rapid integration and immediate impact within Flock’s business development realm.

  • Exceptional understanding of the commercial broker marketplace, competitor carriers, broker business models, and processes.

  • Ability to deliver a consultative sales process, aligning Flock’s value proposition with brokers’ current and future business needs.

  • Comfortable using AI in your daily work, from research and meeting prep to account analysis, and curious about where else it could help you win business.

PREFERABLE

  • Experience building networks of brokers in a Commercial Motor Fleet setting. 

  • Have a broker distribution background with an active panel of brokers in the commercial insurance market. 

  • Can embrace new technologies and products, with experience of successfully distributing these to brokers.

WHAT WE OFFER (in addition to a competitive salary)

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖 

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

At Flock, we typically follow a hybrid working model involving a minimum of 3 days per week spent in the office, which is based in Central London, a few minutes walk from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. Please note if your role involves visit to client sites and broker offices, then this can be substituted for office days.

ONE LAST THING..

Authenticity is important to us. We value the unique qualities and experiences you bring. So if you apply, just be your genuine self. It’s who we want!

Job description

We are seeking an experienced Senior DevOps Consultant to support a defined project at our Headquarters in Berlin.

The assignment is focused on the set-up and further development of our data management and infrastructure platform. The initial consulting engagement is planned for six months, with the possibility of extending the assignment for a further period, potentially up to 12 months in total, subject to project requirements and mutual agreement. The consultant will provide specialist DevOps and data-platform expertise within the scope of the project. The assignment is structured as an independent consulting engagement, with responsibility for delivering agreed project outcomes and technical solutions.

The project supports our Climate Policy Team, which is engaged in various projects on climate change mitigation, in particular on energy system transformation, evaluation of emissions scenarios, the 1.5°C global warming limit and evaluation of national climate action. This includes flagship projects such as the Climate Action Tracker and the National Pathways Explorer, for which data is processed and analysed in-house and then published on the respective project websites.

As part of the assignment, the consultant will work on the shared data platform and infrastructure used across the organisation. Our platform is self-hosted on our own hardware and currently runs PostgreSQL, MinIO, GitLab CI/CD and containerised workloads on Linux. The consultant is expected to organise and perform the assignment independently, within the agreed project scope and in coordination with relevant project stakeholders.
Your responsibilities

  • Build and operate the data platform for advanced analytics and climate modelling, spanning DevOps and data engineering work.
  • Take the platform from single-server deployments to properly separated environments, with orchestration and infrastructure as code.
  • Establish and improve the platform's operational practices, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, capacity planning and performance optimisation.
  • Design and implement the access, identity and secrets model across platform and shared infrastructure.
  • Contribute to the standardisation of production data workflows and platform standards across the organisation.
  • Document what you build (runbooks, architecture notes and handover material) to ensure continuity.
  • Provide technical guidance to data analysts and scientists and support the adoption of good practice in DataOps, security and governance.
  • Evaluate new tools and technologies, run proof-of-concepts, and help define the technical roadmap for our infrastructure.


Your profile

Relevant Tech Skills
Required:

  • Python and shell scripting.
  • Linux servers in production.
  • Container orchestration you have operated yourself, including cluster setup and upgrades (Kubernetes, Docker).
  • Infrastructure as Code and configuration management (Ansible, or equivalent).
  • Operational experience with PostgreSQL (backup and point-in-time recovery, tested restores, version upgrades and connection pooling).
  • Monitoring tools (like Prometheus, Grafana) and alert design.
  • A solid understanding of distributed systems in an on-premise context.
Nice to have:
  • S3-compatible object storage operations (MinIO, Ceph).
  • Identity and directory services like LDAP, Keycloak, or SSO integration across self-hosted tools.
  • Virtualisation platforms (Proxmox, KVM).
  • Have actively applied data governance principles to manage data quality, security, and compliance, and understand how to implement controls that protect sensitive information.
  • Some experience deploying AI projects.
Qualifications
You will ideally have the following qualifications and skills:
  • You have more than 5 years of experience operating Linux servers in production, including on-premise or bare-metal environments (not exclusively managed cloud).
  • Proven ability to build automated pipelines that streamline development, testing and deployment for data-related projects.
  • You are an excellent troubleshooter who excels at diagnosing and fixing data infrastructure and identifying performance bottlenecks.
  • A strong communicator who can collaborate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders in a diverse, interdisciplinary and international environment.
  • Passionate about working at the intersection of Climate Science and Data Engineering (tell us about relevant projects you’ve worked on!).
  • Organised, detail-oriented, and motivated self-starter with strong analytical skills.
  • Proven ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with project stakeholders.
  • Good communication skills in English.


Our offer

Conditions
Application Deadline: The position remains open until filledExpected start of assignment: As soon as possible, by mutual agreement.Location: We would prefer the consultant to be based in Berlin to facilitate effective project coordination, technical collaboration and onboarding, particularly during the initial phase of the assignmentTerms: We are looking for a senior consultant for 6 months with the possibility of extension to up to 12 months in total, subject to project requirements, funding and mutual agreement.

Applications by email or by post can unfortunately not be processed. We encourage you to apply using the application form.

About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA builds technology products used by millions of users across Southeast Asia. As our products and systems scale, we need technical leaders who can solve difficult engineering problems and raise the engineering bar around them.

The Engineering Lead owns technical direction and execution for major products and systems. This is a hands-on role - you will design systems, write code, and drive critical engineering work from idea to production.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning technical design and execution for major products, systems and engineering initiatives.

  • Designing scalable, reliable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Building alongside the team through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Driving architecture decisions and trade-offs across speed, scalability, reliability, cost and maintainability.

  • Turning ambiguous product problems into clear technical solutions and execution plans.

  • Raising engineering quality through stronger system design, testing, security, observability and development practices.

  • Leading technically critical initiatives and mentoring engineers across teams.

 

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep expertise in backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Track record of technically leading major engineering projects from design through production.

  • Ability to make sound technical trade-offs, influence engineers and solve complex production problems.

 

Nice to have

  • Experience scaling engineering teams, systems or development practices through significant growth.

  • Experience operating across multiple products, markets or countries.

 

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

What You'll Own

  • Own a vertical end-to-end - outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

  • Shape the technical design with engineering - system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

  • Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX - and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

  • Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs - licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

  • Apply AI where it earns its place - define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

  • Ship against external gates - build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

  • Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation

What We're Looking For

  • Product leadership - significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

  • Technical foundation - solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

  • Domain - experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

  • AI judgement - hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

  • Nice to have - engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

AYLASHES ist eine erfolgreiche D2C-Beauty-Brand für DIY-Wimpernextensions. Mit unseren Produkten können sich unsere Kundinnen ihren individuellen Studio-Look in wenigen Minuten selbst zu Hause kreieren.

Für unsere weitere Entwicklung suchen wir einen erfahrenen Freelance Performance Creative Designer, der visuell starke und performanceorientierte Creatives für unsere Werbeanzeigen, Landingpages und unseren Onlineshop entwickelt.

Du solltest nicht nur ein ausgezeichnetes Gespür für Ästhetik, Typografie und Bildsprache besitzen, sondern auch verstehen, wie Designs im E-Commerce funktionieren: von einem aufmerksamkeitsstarken Einstieg über eine klare visuelle Hierarchie bis hin zu einer überzeugenden Produktinszenierung und einem eindeutigen Call-to-Action.

Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst performanceorientierte statische Werbeanzeigen und Grafiken für Meta, Instagram, TikTok, Google und weitere digitale Kanäle.
  • Du gestaltest unterschiedliche Creative Angles, Hooks, Layouts und Varianten, damit wir Botschaften und visuelle Ansätze gezielt testen können.
  • Du verwandelst Produktbilder, UGC-Material, Testimonials, Benefits und Werbetexte in aufmerksamkeitsstarke und verkaufsorientierte Creatives.
  • Du gestaltest visuelle Konzepte, Seitenlayouts und einzelne Bereiche für Landingpages, Produktseiten und unseren Onlineshop.
  • Du entwickelst unter anderem Hero Sections, Produkt-Benefit-Grafiken, Vergleichsdarstellungen, Anwendungsanleitungen, Vorher-Nachher-Visuals, Trust-Elemente und weitere Conversion-Elemente.
  • Du sorgst dafür, dass Marke, Produkt, Anwendung, Vorteile und Ergebnisse von AYLASHES hochwertig und verständlich präsentiert werden.
  • Du adaptierst Creatives für unterschiedliche Plattformen, Platzierungen und Formate – insbesondere 1:1, 4:5 und 9:16 sowie weitere Display- und Webformate.
  • Du achtest bei allen Formaten auf Safe Zones, Lesbarkeit, mobile Darstellung und eine konsistente visuelle Qualität.
  • Du entwickelst aus erfolgreichen Ads neue Varianten und Iterationen, beispielsweise mit anderen Hooks, Bildern, Headlines, Farben, Layouts oder CTAs.
  • Du setzt bestehende Brand-Vorgaben sicher um und entwickelst unsere visuelle Kommunikation gemeinsam mit uns weiter.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Marketing-Team zusammen, setzt Feedback schnell und zuverlässig um und bringst eigene Ideen und Empfehlungen ein.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Gestaltung von Performance Creatives für Meta, TikTok, Google oder vergleichbare Paid-Media-Kanäle.
  • Du besitzt ein aussagekräftiges Portfolio mit relevanten Werbeanzeigen, Landingpages oder E-Commerce-Designs – idealerweise aus den Bereichen Beauty, Fashion, Lifestyle oder D2C.
  • Du verstehst die grundlegende Creative Strategy hinter erfolgreichen Werbeanzeigen und weißt, warum Hook, visuelle Hierarchie, Produktinszenierung, Lesbarkeit, Social Proof und CTA entscheidend sind.
  • Du hast Erfahrung mit conversionorientiertem Web- und Landingpage-Design und kannst ansprechende Layouts entwickeln, die auch auf mobilen Geräten funktionieren.
  • Du beherrschst relevante Designprogramme sicher, beispielsweise Figma, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign oder vergleichbare Tools.
  • Du hast ein sehr gutes Gespür für Ästhetik, Typografie, Farben, Komposition, Bildauswahl und modernes E-Commerce-Design.
  • Du kannst Informationen visuell priorisieren und auch komplexere Produktvorteile schnell verständlich darstellen.
  • Du weißt, wie man eine hochwertige Markenwirkung mit klarer, performanceorientierter Kommunikation verbindet.
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und detailgenau und hältst vereinbarte Deadlines zuverlässig ein.
  • Du kannst deutschsprachige Werbetexte sicher verarbeiten und erkennst, wenn eine Headline oder Botschaft im Design nicht optimal funktioniert.
  • Erfahrung mit A/B-Tests, Creative Iterations und der Auswertung von Ad-Performance ist ein starkes Plus.
  • Erfahrung mit einfachen Animationen, Motion Graphics oder KI-gestützter Bildbearbeitung ist ebenfalls von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Benefits

  • Flexible und ortsunabhängige Zusammenarbeit auf Freelance-Basis.
  • Die Möglichkeit einer langfristigen Zusammenarbeit mit regelmäßigen Projekten und planbaren Aufgaben.
  • Abwechslungsreiche Designprojekte für Paid Social, Google Ads, Landingpages, Produktseiten und unseren Onlineshop.
  • Klare Briefings, vorhandene Brand-Guidelines, Produktmaterialien und Werbetexte als Grundlage für deine Arbeit.
  • Direkte Kommunikation, schnelle Entscheidungen und konkrete Feedback-Loops.
  • Einblicke in die Performance deiner Creatives, damit du nachvollziehen kannst, welche Designs funktionieren und warum.
  • Raum für eigene Ideen, neue Designkonzepte und kreative Testansätze.
  • Die Möglichkeit, die visuelle Weiterentwicklung einer wachsenden D2C-Beauty-Brand aktiv mitzugestalten.
  • Faire und transparente Vergütung, abgestimmt auf Erfahrung, Qualität und Projektumfang.

Wir benötigen weder einen klassischen Lebenslauf noch ein Anschreiben. Entscheidend sind die Qualität deiner Arbeit, dein Gespür für Ästhetik und deine bisherigen Ergebnisse.

Bitte sende uns mit deiner Bewerbung:

  • fünf bis acht deiner stärksten und relevantesten Arbeiten,
  • Beispiele für Performance Ads sowie, wenn vorhanden, Landingpages oder E-Commerce-Designs,
  • eine kurze Information dazu, was du bei den gezeigten Projekten übernommen hast,
  • wenn möglich, konkrete Ergebnisse oder Erkenntnisse zur Performance deiner Arbeiten,
  • deine aktuelle Verfügbarkeit und ungefähre wöchentliche Kapazität,
  • deine Preisvorstellung pro Creative, Stunden- oder Paketpreis.

Wenn du bereits an einer besonders erfolgreichen Werbeanzeige oder Landingpage gearbeitet hast, zeige uns gerne, was daran funktioniert hat und welchen Beitrag du geleistet hast.

Bewerbungen ohne relevantes Portfolio können wir leider nicht berücksichtigen. Wenn deine Arbeiten und dein Profil zu uns passen, erhältst du von uns einen kurzen und klar abgegrenzten Test-Task.

Wir freuen uns darauf, deine Arbeiten zu sehen und gemeinsam Designs zu entwickeln, die nicht nur hochwertig aussehen, sondern Aufmerksamkeit erzeugen, Vertrauen aufbauen und echte Ergebnisse erzielen.

Want to make a difference?

As Senior Controller (all genders), you play a key role in the financial steering of ARMEDANGELS. With your strategic perspective on numbers, processes, and business performance, you help ensure that sustainable growth is built on a strong and reliable financial foundation.

You take ownership of further developing budgeting, forecasting, and reporting processes, create transparency around financial performance, and support data-driven decision-making across the business. In doing so, you combine financial excellence with our ambition to operate responsibly and with long-term impact in mind.


Who we are...

Since 2007, ARMEDANGELS has been proving that fashion can be different: innovative and timeless, produced according to responsible standards for people and planet. No wage slavery, no toxic chemicals, no cheap throwaway goods.

What started as a simple idea – printing T-shirts and donating proceeds to social projects – has grown into a company that now ranks among Europe’s leading sustainable lifestyle labels. With a 190-strong team and four collections a year, we show that responsibility and great product design can go hand in hand.


What is the job about?

Strategic Financial Planning & Analysis

You lead and further develop our budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning processes, ensuring they are aligned with our business and growth objectives.

You analyze financial performance, conduct variance analyses, and derive actionable recommendations to support better business decisions.

Internal Controls & Compliance

You will develop and strengthen internal control mechanisms, helping to identify risks early on and ensure compliance with regulatory and internal standards. 

You will assist with annual financial statement audits in accordance with the German Commercial Code (HGB), participate in audits, and, when necessary, coordinate the implementation of required measures from a controlling perspective.

Financial Reporting & Performance Monitoring

You oversee the preparation of meaningful financial reports, including P&L, cash flow, and balance sheet analysis, creating transparency on the company’s financial performance.

You use KPIs and data-driven insights to identify opportunities and support financial steering.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Strategic Support

You work closely with Finance, Operations, IT, and other business functions to integrate financial insights into broader business planning.

You prepare decision-ready analyses for senior stakeholders and help ensure strategic choices are grounded in reliable financial data.

Team Leadership & Continuous Improvement

You support and develop colleagues in Finance and Controlling, fostering a culture of ownership, transparency, and continuous improvement.

You drive process enhancements and introduce tools, methods, and best practices that improve efficiency and quality in a sustainable way.


We'd love to hear from you if you have

Professional

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field
  • 5–7+ years of experience in controlling, financial planning, or comparable finance roles
  • Strong expertise in budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting
  • Proficiency in Excel, ERP systems, and financial management software.  Experience with analytics tools such as Looker, PowerBI, or Tableau is a plus
  • Experience with internal controls and compliance-related processes
  • You have knowledge of the German Commercial Code (HGB) and a solid understanding of accounting principles, enabling you to effectively integrate controlling and accounting perspectives.
Personal
  • Strategic and analytical mindset
  • Structured, precise, and solution-oriented way of working
  • Strong sense of ownership and responsibility
  • Excellent communication skills and confidence in working with different stakeholders
  • Motivation to support teams and actively improve processes


What can you expect?

Inspiring work environment: Work in an innovative company that operates as sustainably as possible and continuously sets new standards.

Flexibility: Trust-based working hours and the option to work in a hybrid setup.

Team spirit: Enjoy legendary team events, a historic office space, and plenty of dog-friendly energy.

Benefits: €50 monthly benefit via guudcard, ARMEDANGELS shopping vouchers, attractive employee discounts, a JobRad or Germany Ticket, and a company pension scheme.

Support: Our Employee Assistance Program is available to support you confidentially in any life situation.

Come as you are: No dress code – just be yourself.


Good to know before you apply

We appreciate diverse interests, courage, and the drive to make things happen.

Please apply online via the application button and include the following information:

  • Your pronouns and preferred name, if applicable
  • Your CV
  • Your earliest possible start date and salary expectations
  • A few words on why you are excited to join ARMEDANGELS

This helps us get a well-rounded picture of how well we might fit together.

Thank you for your time and interest!

We are looking for someone with a strong accounting foundation who has expanded – or would like to further expand – into broader finance topics and take on more responsibility across the finance function.

You will gain direct exposure to the full finance function of a fast-growing fintech, report directly to the Head of Finance, and have the opportunity to grow your role within the Finance Team over time. Candidates with appropriate senior-level experience may join at Senior Manager level.

From day one, you will play a critical role in strengthening and optimising bunch’s financial operations as the company grows and scales across markets.


What You’ll Do

  • Handle all our preparatory accounting (including assigning cost centers and cost units) on both the creditor and debtor side (Kreditoren- und Debitorenbuchhaltung) and be responsible for exports to our external accountants in all our jurisdictions
  • Own our spend management processes, including weekly invoice review and approval, credit card and employee reimbursement management, and direct debit setup, and make sure we pay our bills on time
  • Run quarterly and annual invoicing across all products and jurisdictions and take the lead on reducing manual effort by working with our analytics and other teams to improve and automate our invoicing setup. You'll also track client payments and flag overdue accounts
  • Support our monthly close by coordinating with external accountants across all jurisdictions and entities, ensuring timely delivery of monthly and annual accounts and that our external partners always have what they need on time
  • Support on our regular tax filings, such as for VAT, across our entities
  • Conduct monthly payroll reviews and serve as the internal point of contact for payroll-related questions — including social security, health insurance, pension contributions, and employee benefits — as well as financial employee policies such as expense reimbursement
  • Support equity financing rounds alongside Legal, Strategy, and FP&A — including due diligence and data room preparation. You'll also pick up one-off banking and insurance needs as they arise


What you bring

  •  At least 2–4 years of experience in an in-house finance role, reputable consultancy, or completed training as a tax clerk (Steuerfachangestellte/r) or accountant (Bilanzbuchhalter/in). This role has flexibility in its seniority — for more senior candidates beyond 5-6 years experience, we can offer a “Senior Manager” role
  • Mastery of the fundamentals of accounting and familiarity with common tax issues arising in a multi-jurisdictional company
  • Hands-on experience with accounting, billing, and spend management tools (e.g. DATEV, Stripe, Moss, Spendesk) or similar systems
  • Highly organised and reliable, with a track record of owning recurring processes independently
  • Genuine interest in process optimisation and automation — you notice inefficiencies and want to fix them
  • Strong attention to detail and quality orientation
  • A proactive, solution-oriented mindset and comfort handling new responsibilities
  • High level of ownership, reliability, and flexibility
  • SaaS and/or fund industry experience is a plus
  • Fluency in English (C1+ level), at least B1 in German
  • Be excited about working in a fluid, innovative, fast-paced, and creative environment and about being a part of bunch's culture
  • Diverse backgrounds are strongly encouraged


What we offer

  • Competitive salary
  • Customizable benefits package (wellbeing, sport, mobility, food, and more)
  • 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays
  • Remote-flexible hybrid (3 days/week in office)
  • Up to 4 remote calendar weeks a year
  • Work with a diverse team of 120+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains


Hiring process

  1. People Team Interview (30 min) – Meet us & ensure mutual fit
  2. Deep Dive Interview (45 min) – Collaboration, ownership, and culture
  3. Case Study (90 min) – Technical skillset evaluation with our hiring manager
  4. Final Stakeholder Interview (60 min) – Meet your important stakeholders


Contact information

Interested? We look forward to hearing from you!

data.description:
Deine Rolle

Freshly cooked food. Everywhere. All the time.
    
Mit unseren Robotern verändern wir, wie die Welt kocht, isst und genießt. Durch Technologie, die Gastronomien entlastet, automatisiert frisches Essen zubereitet und kulinarische Qualität auf ein neues, skalierbares Level hebt. Zugänglich für alle. Überall und jederzeit. Dafür geben wir alles. Auf allen Ebenen, in jedem Team und in jeder Funktion.

Als Werkstudent:in im Foodservice unserer Robotic Kitchen Operations sorgst du dafür, dass unser autonomer Kochroboter vor Ort bei unserem Kunden in Heikendorf (bei Kiel) reibungslos läuft. Du bedienst und überwachst das System im laufenden Betrieb, bereitest frische Zutaten vor, behältst die Kochprozesse im Blick – und bist gleichzeitig herzliche:r Gastgeber:in für unsere Gäste.

Diese Aufgaben übernimmst du: 

  • Roboter-Betrieb: Du bedienst und überwachst unseren Kochroboter im laufenden Betrieb – vor Ort bei unserem Kunden in Heikendorf (bei Kiel).
  • Mise en Place: Du bereitest Zutaten frisch vor und befüllst damit den Roboter.
  • Qualitätsüberwachung: Du behältst jeden Kochschritt im Blick und sorgst für konstante Qualität und korrekte Portionen.
  • Gästebetreuung: Du begrüßt unsere Gäste herzlich, beantwortest ihre Fragen und unterstützt sie im Umgang mit unserem Roboter.
  • Sauberkeit & Hygiene: Du hältst die Station rund um den Roboter sauber, prüfst das System täglich und sorgst für einwandfreie Hygiene nach HACCP-Standard.


Dein Profil

Du brennst für innovative Technologien, begeisterst dich für die Rolle und willst gemeinsam mit uns die Welten von Tech & Kulinarik weiter revolutionieren? Let’s get cooking!

Diese Eigenschaften bringst du idealerweise mit: 

  • Neugier & Offenheit: Du hast Lust, mit unserem Kochroboter zu arbeiten, probierst gerne Neues aus und bist fasziniert von innovativer Technik in der Küche.
  • Freude an Technik & Kulinarik: Du verbindest Begeisterung für moderne Technologien mit einem Faible für gutes Essen.
  • Motivation & Hands-on: Du bist motiviert, zeigst Energie und packst auch gerne selbst mit an.
  • Flexibilität & Zuverlässigkeit: Ob unter der Woche oder am Wochenende – du bist flexibel einsetzbar und auf dich ist Verlass.
  • Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse: Du sprichst gut Deutsch und hast mind. Englisch-Grundkenntnisse – zur sicheren Kommunikation mit Gästen und Team.
  • Gastronomie-Erfahrung als Plus: Erste Erfahrungen aus Küche und/oder Service sind ein Bonus – aber keine Voraussetzung.

Our mission

At LOGEX, we help healthcare providers improve outcomes through data-driven insights. Every day, hospitals and healthcare organizations across Europe rely on our financial, operational, clinical, and patient pathway data to make better decisions.

Your impact and responsibilities

As Security Architect, you will report directly to the Head of Information Security & Compliance and play a key role in strengthening LOGEX's security maturity. This is not a traditional enterprise architecture role focused on creating frameworks and presentations. We are looking for a security practitioner who enjoys rolling up their sleeves, working closely with engineering teams, solving real security challenges, and driving measurable risk reduction. You will work alongside software engineers, data engineers, and platform teams across multiple countries to ensure security is built into everything we do.

Your team

Security Architecture & Standards

Cloud & Platform Security

Detection & Incident Response

  • Improve logging, monitoring, and threat detection capabilities

Your profile

RYZE Digital ist eine der führenden Agenturgruppen für digitale Unternehmenskommunikation im deutschsprachigen Raum – aufgebaut über eine konsequente Buy-&-Build-Strategie. data.description:
Your role at Ocumeda

As Staff Software Engineer (m/f/d) you are the engineer who makes hard, unclear or broken things tractable. You know how our platform works end to end and you shape it as you go. Your focus is our full-stack platform: the web application our doctors, our optician partners, and their customers use daily, and the services behind it.
This is an individual contributor role. No direct reports, real technical authority: you set direction on architecture and engineering practice, and you build in the same codebase as everyone else in the team. Staff/Senior here means deeper, not further from the code. Your job is to keep our systems fast to iterate, reliable in production, and ready for international expansion and scaling.

  • Own the architecture of our full-stack platform – frontend, backend, data, AWS – and evolve it under real product pressure instead of rewriting it
  • Own our testing strategy: where we invest in unit, integration and end-to-end coverage, what we deliberately do not test, and how tests stay fast enough that nobody skips them
  • Push our agentic coding practice forward: tooling, guardrails and testing discipline that make us faster without putting unverified code into a live product
  • Shape scope together with product: surface the cheap 80 % solution, and say clearly when something is not worth building
  • Build so that what ships is operable and auditable by design (e.g. ISO 27001, ISO 13485), without turning engineering into paperwork
  • Go wherever the problem is – a scaling bottleneck one week, a broken integration the next – you fix it properly


What makes you a great fit

  • Several years of professional software engineering experience (roughly 7+), most of it on systems that reached real users
  • Deeply hands-on across the stack: strong in the frontend, at home in the backend, comfortable in the infrastructure and web technologies around it

data.description:
Intro

Adsquare's mission is centered on:

  • Passion: Solving complex challenges with exceptional people, technology, and data.

  • Niche: Specializing in Location Intelligence for Programmatic Advertisers.


Our work is guided by our core values, and we look for candidates who embody them:

  • Drive: Turning ambition into action that brings valuable outcomes.

  • Resilience: Adapting, persevering, and growing stronger through challenges.

  • No BS: Upholding honesty, transparency, and clear communication.

  • Humble: Valuing modesty and letting results speak for themselves.

  • Moral Compass: Acting with fairness, integrity, and respect.


About the team

You'll join Adsquare's Data Products team, responsible for the pipelines and signals that power our Location Intelligence solutions. Working closely with our Lead PM for Data Products and a squad of data engineers, you'll help ingest, process, and scale the supplier and panel data that fuels our products. Your squad sits at the intersection of engineering, data governance, and downstream teams like Measurement and Activation, ensuring the signals we deliver are fast, reliable, and trustworthy.


Your Mission

As Product Owner for SDV Data Products (f/m/d), you'll own your squad's delivery, turning strategy into clear, testable backlog items while managing the technical scale of our core data pipelines. You'll be the primary technical counterpart to our data suppliers and panel partners, driving the operational reliability that keeps our signals fresh and trusted.


Your Profile

  • 3-5 years of experience as a Product Owner or technical PM, ideally in AdTech, MarTech, or another data-heavy ecosystem.

  • Strong at managing delivery and technical scale: sequencing complex backend work, mapping dependencies, and scoping against time, whether working with engineers, architects, or integration teams.

  • Operationally rigorous: comfortable thinking in SLIs, SLOs, freshness, match rate, and MTTR, not just features shipped, and skilled at running a tight, testable backlog.

  • Data-fluent, with required SQL proficiency: able to independently query internal data sources to investigate supplier data, panel quality, and pipeline KPIs, and bring quantified evidence into prioritisation.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity: able to make decisions with limited information and translate business intent clearly for engineering.

  • A privacy-aware product thinker who understands data governance and how evolving privacy frameworks affect upstream ingestion and pipeline logic.

  • A clear communicator across altitudes, able to translate strategy into specs and engineering reality into product trade-offs.

  • A true owner who drives outcomes without step-by-step direction and surfaces tensions upward rather than resolving them quietly.


What you will do

  • Own and maintain your squad's backlog, working closely with the Lead PM for Data Products to translate strategy into clear, testable user stories.

  • Lead the roadmap for modernising, scaling, and optimising our core data ingestion and processing pipelines to handle high-throughput workloads.

  • Manage internal dependencies — SLAs, schema contracts, and joint roadmap touchpoints — with downstream squads such as Measurement, Activation, and Data Products.

  • Coordinate releases of new schemas, ingestion endpoints, match logic changes, and signal product enhancements.

  • Act as the primary PO-level counterpart to data supplier and panel partner technical teams, co-owning ingestion specs and schema contracts.

  • Support the Lead PM on new supplier partnerships and panel expansion through feasibility input, integration scoping, and prototype delivery.

  • Define, own, and report on operational KPIs such as signal freshness, SLA adherence, panel coverage, schema validation pass rate, and match rate.

  • Establish SLIs, SLOs, and escalation paths in partnership with engineering, and own the operational visibility layer (dashboards, alerts) that surfaces data product health.


Nice to Have

  • Based in Berlin, or open to working from our Berlin office periodically.

  • Prior experience collaborating directly with identity vendors, panel providers, or purchase-data suppliers on schema and integration work.


Our Software Stack

  • SQL

  • Jira

  • Confluence

  • API Documentation tools


Why us?

On top of a competitive package…

  • We are open to flexible work models: we work in a hybrid mode.

  • To encourage education and professional growth, we offer an individual yearly budget of €1,200.

  • You are entitled to 30 vacation days per year.

  • Public transport contribution.

  • We care about your mental health and provide coaching and counseling sessions through our collaboration with the Fürstenberg Institut.

  • We equip you with the latest hardware and all the tools you need to thrive.

65,000 - 70,000

  2. VP Product interview (45 min)

  4. Team interview (30 min)

Work model

Hybrid

Asap

data.description:
Dein täglicher Verantwortungsbereich:

  • Der operative Betrieb unseres internen IT-Bereichs liegt in deinen Händen: Du packst selbst mit an, strukturierst Themen und sorgst dafür, dass technische Aufgaben pragmatisch umgesetzt werden.
  • Gemeinsam mit einem kleinen Team stellst du den zuverlässigen Betrieb unserer Office IT-Infrastruktur und unserer Microsoft-basierten Arbeitsumgebung sicher.
  • Bei technischen Fragestellungen gehst du lösungsorientiert vor, analysierst Ursachen und unterstützt aktiv beider Umsetzung.
  • IT-Projekte planst du strukturiert, priorisierst Aufgaben sinnvoll und bringst Themen gemeinsam mit internen Stakeholdern und externen Dienstleistern voran.
  • Externe Dienstleister steuerst du verbindlich und stellst sicher, dass Leistungen, Verantwortlichkeiten und technische Entscheidungen zu unseren Anforderungen passen.
  • Unseren IT-Support entwickelst du schrittweise zu einem strukturierteren Service-Modell weiter und übersetzt wiederkehrende Themen in klare Prozesse.
  • Jira Service Management gestaltest du gemeinsam mit dem Team als zentrale Plattform für Anfragen und Support weiter.
  • In IT- und Informationssicherheits-Audits sowie regelmäßigen Zertifizierungen sorgst du dafür, dass Prozesse, Verantwortlichkeiten und Nachweise sauber aufgebaut und gepflegt werden.


Deine Kompetenzen:

  • Du bringst fundierte praktische Erfahrung im Betrieb und in der Weiterentwicklung moderner IT-Umgebungen mit.
  • Microsoft-basierte Unternehmensumgebungen sind dir vertraut und du verstehst, wie eine sichere und skalierbare IT für ein wachsendes Unternehmen aufgebaut wird.
  • IT-Projekte kannst du strukturieren, Prioritäten setzen und unterschiedliche Aufgaben, Beteiligte und Abhängigkeiten zuverlässig zusammenführen.
  • Technische Lösungsansätze beurteilst du sicher und gehst bei Störungen pragmatisch, analytisch und umsetzungsorientiert vor.
  • Mit Microsoft 365, Entra ID und Intune hast du bereits gearbeitet.
  • Die Zusammenarbeit mit externen IT-Dienstleistern ist dir vertraut und du kannst technische Empfehlungen kritisch einordnen.
  • Erste Erfahrung in der fachlichen Anleitung von Kolleg:innenist hilfreich, aber keine Voraussetzung; wichtiger ist, dass du Verantwortung übernehmen und dich in eine Führungsrolle weiterentwickeln möchtest.
  • Deutsch und Englisch beherrschst du sicher und kommunizierst mit technischen Teams ebenso souverän wie mit nicht-technischen Stakeholdern.


Unsere Werte, dein Mindset:

  • Team First: Ein Team, ein Ziel - Gemeinsam sind wir stark. Wir wachsen durch gegenseitige Unterstützung.
  • Customer Success Is Our DNA: Identifiziere, hinterfrage und verfolge die Ziele Deines Kunden. Feiert gemeinsam den Erfolg.
  • Never Stop Reinventing: Sei offen für Neues und gehe Veränderungen mutig an. Hinterfrage Prozesse, liefere Lösungsvorschläge und neue Ideen.
  • Be Yourself And Make Goals Work: Sei Du selbst. Erreiche Großes!


Deine Benefits bei uns:

  • Remote Work: Flexibles Arbeitsmodell - arbeite bis zu 100 % remote innerhalb Deutschlands oder nutze unser modernes Office in Hamburg.
  • Urlaub: Mehr Zeit für das, was dir wichtig ist - zusätzlich zu 30 Urlaubstagen kannst du deinen Jahresurlaub durch Gehaltsumwandlung auf bis zu 40 Tage erhöhen.
  • Workation: Arbeiten, wo du dich inspirieren lässt - arbeite einmal pro Jahr remote aus dem europäischen Ausland. Nach zwei Jahren Betriebszugehörigkeit sind sogar weitere internationale Workation-Möglichkeiten möglich.
  • Gesundheit: Deine Gesundheit liegt uns am Herzen - mit unserer betrieblichen Krankenversicherung erhältst du ein jährliches Gesundheitsbudget für zahlreiche Gesundheitsleistungen. 
  • Dein Wahlbenefit: Du entscheidest, was am besten zu deinem Alltag passt - wähle zwischen einem Zuschuss zum Urban Sports Club, einem bezuschussten JobTicket oder einer Edenred-Sachbezugskarte für deine Einkäufe. 
  • JobRad: Ob für den Arbeitsweg oder deine Freizeit - lease dein JobRad über uns und profitiere von attraktiven steuerlichen Vorteilen. 
  • Altersvorsorge: Wir denken heute schon an morgen - sichere deine Zukunft mit unserer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge inklusive 20 % Arbeitgeberzuschuss. 
  • Verantwortung & Entwicklung: Raum für Eigeninitiative statt starrer Hierarchien - übernimm Verantwortung, bringe deine Ideen ein und gestalte die Zukunft der Reos Gruppe aktiv mit.
  • Networking: Zweimal im Jahr kommt die gesamte Reos Gruppe in Hamburg zusammen - freue dich auf unvergessliche Firmenevents, persönlichen Austausch und echte gemeinsame Erlebnisse.

Our product & tech teams in Xberg - the heart of Berlin - are a highly diverse and multicultural bunch. They make sure that we can make a difference and scale the energy transition in Germany and work closely together with all departments. 
 
Join our product & tech teams and pave the way for climate neutral living.

data.title: (Senior) Software Engineer (M/F/D) - Tools & Automation

data.description:
Abstract

Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models can recover scene geometry directly from images or videos without costly scene-specific optimization. By combining large-scale pre-training, multi-view reasoning, and strong geometric priors, these models provide an efficient alternative to traditional reconstruction pipelines such as Structure-from-Motion, NeRF, and optimization-based 3D Gaussian Splatting.

Despite recent progress, current models remain sensitive to challenging real-world conditions. Occlusions, moving objects, illumination changes, nighttime scenes, reflections, rain, fog, and snow can result in incomplete geometry, unreliable correspondences, and temporally inconsistent predictions. Improving robustness under such conditions is essential for autonomous driving and robotic perception.

As a working student, you will support the development of robust feed-forward reconstruction models for dynamic scenes. You will investigate methods for handling occlusion, changing illumination, and adverse weather, and explore how large reconstruction models can serve as general-purpose geometric backbones for downstream 3D scene understanding, particularly semantic occupancy prediction and 4D occupancy forecasting.


These tasks interest you

  • Develop and evaluate feed-forward 3D reconstruction models for dynamic scenes using monocular or multi-view image sequences.
  • Investigate reconstruction robustness under partial and long-term occlusions, moving objects, and incomplete observations.
  • Develop methods to improve geometric consistency under illumination changes, low-light conditions, shadows, and reflections.
  • Evaluate and improve model performance under adverse weather conditions such as rain, fog, snow, and reduced visibility.
  • Compare the developed methods with relevant baselines and document technical and experimental results.


That makes you stand out

  • You are currently pursuing a degree in computer science, artificial intelligence, robotics, electrical engineering, data science, or a related field.
  • You have excellent programming skills in Python as well as hands-on experience with PyTorch.
  • You have a good understanding of computer vision, deep learning, 3D geometry, or multi-view vision.
  • Experience with depth estimation, optical flow, point clouds, camera pose estimation, NeRF, 3D Gaussian Splatting, or 3D reconstruction is highly beneficial.
  • Your language skills enable you to perform your role in English (at least C1 level). Knowledge of German is desirable but not required.


Salary information

Within our standardized and transparent salary framework, the pay for this position ranges from €15.50 to €19.50 per hour and is based on various factors, such as qualifications and experience.

As a Working Student within Career Services, you will support the day-to-day delivery of career services, student engagement activities, events and employability initiatives at BSBI.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is organised, proactive and comfortable managing different tasks and priorities. You will work closely with the Careers Advisors and will often be one of the first points of contact for students engaging with Career Services.

In this role, you will:

  • Act as a first point of contact for Career Services, helping students and recent graduates understand the services, resources and support available to them.
  • Help manage the Careers shared mailbox, responding to general student enquiries, directing queries to the appropriate team member and following up where required.
  • Work with tasks assigned through Microsoft Planner, keeping track of deadlines, updating task status and ensuring assigned activities are completed on time.
  • Act as an ambassador for JobTeaser, helping students understand the platform and encouraging greater engagement with career opportunities, resources and events.
  • Support the preparation, coordination and delivery of career workshops, webinars and other employability initiatives, including participant communication, materials, attendance and session support.
  • Assist with the organisation and delivery of employer events, career fairs, company visits and networking activities at the Berlin campus.
  • Help create and distribute student-facing communications and promotional materials for career programmes, workshops, events and opportunities.
  • Support Career Services with student engagement and programme administration, including registrations, attendance records, feedback and basic reporting.
  • Collaborate with colleagues across Campus Management, Marketing, Student Life and other BSBI teams to support Careers initiatives.
  • Provide general administrative and operational support to the Careers Advisors and contribute to other Career Services projects as required.


Your profile


  • Currently enrolled as a BA or MA-level student at BSBI.
  • Excellent command of English (C2 level or equivalent), with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organisation and task-management skills, with the ability to manage several responsibilities and deadlines at the same time.
  • Some previous experience using task-management or collaboration tools such as Microsoft Planner.
  • Comfortable working with Microsoft 365, particularly Outlook, Teams, Word, PowerPoint and Excel.
  • A genuine interest in careers, employability and professional development, with an understanding of the skills employers look for in students and graduates.
  • Strong intercultural communication skills and confidence working with students from diverse backgrounds.
  • Empathy and the ability to communicate with students in an impartial, professional and supportive manner. Training and guidance will be provided.
  • A proactive mindset, you are comfortable taking ownership of assigned tasks, asking questions when needed and following through to completion.
  • Strong attention to detail, particularly when working with student communications, registrations, data and administrative processes.
  • Reliable, punctual and accountable, with the ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

    • You must remain an active student at BSBI until at least April 2027
    • Flexible working hours with a total of 20 hours per week
    • €13.90 per hour
    • Six-month employment contract
What you will gain

This role provides practical experience in Career Services, student engagement, event coordination, project and task management, professional communication and stakeholder collaboration within an international higher-education environment.
You will work directly with Career Services professionals and gain hands-on exposure to the programmes, platforms and activities that support students in their transition from university into the professional world.


Why us?

  • An international environment with a multicultural audience and a meaningful social impact

  • Support in achieving your professional goals and development

  • Opportunities for career growth alongside BSBI, including leadership roles

  • Extensive training to equip you with the knowledge and skills needed to excel

  • Work in a young, dynamic and positive culture that fosters collaboration

  • Be at the forefront of an exciting educational opportunity, leading the way forward and growing with BSBI

Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO

As the Tech Lead for the backend, frontend, mobile and fullstack software engineers, you will own and shape the architecture of the underlying services as well as their technical roadmap for the services that together create Treeline, our application that helps predict and prevent wildfires, storm events and generally power and train outages due to vegetation, weather and climate.

Technically, that means rendering and querying large volumes of geospatial data efficiently in both browser, mobile and backend, handling complex and custom business logic, writing the services that make that fast, and building integrations for the growing number of third-party consumers of our services.

We are a team of five engineers today, actively growing, embedded in a cross-functional group of product managers, UX/UI designers, data, DevOps, ML, and geospatial engineering experts. You will not be the only person responsible for any system you touch and we’re a friendly bunch.


Your challenge

  • Lead, support and coordinate the team that builds Treeline while still being around 60% hands-on
  • Architect, build and extend features end-to-end that handle large volumes of geospatial data, with attention to UX and design
  • Design and build well-designed, performant API endpoints and backend services used by partners and customers
  • Coordinate tightly with other functions in cross-functional temporary squads
  • Shape and influence how your team works and how we work together in a greater context

Stack:
  • Frontend: React, TypeScript
  • Backend: NestJS, TypeORM
  • Mobile: React Native
  • Database: PostgreSQL (including geospatial workloads, PostGIS and OGC)
  • Infrastructure & CI/CD: AWS, GitLab


Your profile

Must have

  • First experience as a techlead, knowing that the team and product takes priority over your own hands-on work, always
  • Strong Backend experience with NestJS, Express, or Node.js
  • High level of TypeScript, React in production (Vue or Preact also fine — we care that you know a component model well, not which one)
  • Familiarity with mobile development, especially React Native
  • You've worked in a codebase with CI/CD and code review, and can find your way around a system you didn't build
  • You've used AI-assisted coding in your actual day-to-day, not just tried it once
Nice to have
  • Spec-driven or test-driven development, agentic or otherwise
  • Web-based geospatial / GIS work
  • An eye for design and UX — enough to make small design calls without needing a mockup for everything


Your Benefits

  • The opportunity to create a product that can improve business processes and lives across the globe.

Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO

LiveEO transforms Earth Observation data and AI into actionable intelligence for critical infrastructure and supply-chain operators around the world. Our platforms Treeline, SurfaceScout, and TradeAware, help utilities, energy companies, rail operators, and global supply chains monitor vegetation risk, third-party interference, ground changes, and deforestation exposure across millions of kilometers of assets and supply chains, from space.

We're hiring our first Sales Engineering team lead to build and lead a truly global Sales Engineering organization, unifying our regional SE teams across North America, EMEA, and APAC into one consistent, high-performing technical sales function. As Director Sales Engineering (f/m/x), you will own the strategy, people, and technical rigor behind LiveEO's global pre-sales motion. You'll lead a team of regional Sales Engineers, act as the company's most senior technical voice with enterprise customers, and be the standard-bearer for how LiveEO qualifies, quantifies, and wins deals. You'll partner closely with the VP Pre-Sales & Professional Services, VP Sales, CRO, and Product leadership to make sure every region sells with the same technical credibility, the same value discipline, and the same customer-first mindset.

  • Build, lead, and scale an international Sales Engineering team across North America, EMEA, and APAC; own hiring, onboarding, coaching, and career development for regional SEs and SE managers.

Wofür wir stehen:

“We drive digital transformation end-to-end - from strategy to execution. Creating measurable progress and real impact for our clients.”
 
Stillstand? Nicht mit uns. Wir glauben: Alles ist BETA und genau darin liegt die Chance für Fortschritt. Darum hinterfragen wir Bestehendes, wagen Neues und gestalten die digitale Transformation unserer Kunden aktiv mit.
Was uns auszeichnet? Wir denken ganzheitlich. Von der strategischen Beratung bis zur Implementierung begleiten wir unsere Kunden End-to-End – mit Kreativität, technologischer Exzellenz und einem tiefen Verständnis für ihre Geschäftsmodelle. So entstehen messbarer Fortschritt und nachhaltiger Impact.
 
Und jetzt kommst du: Wir suchen Menschen mit Neugier, Ambition und dem Mut, Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Menschen, die Lust haben, Neues zu lernen, unsere Kunden zu begeistern und gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen.


Deine Aufgaben:

Deine Mission: Suche hat sich in zwei Jahren mehr verändert als in den zehn davor. Unsere Kunden, B2B Hidden Champions aus Manufacturing, Industrial Goods und Wholesale, 300 Mio. bis 5 Mrd. EUR Umsatz, merken das gerade: organischer Traffic bricht ein, obwohl die Rankings stabil sind. Recherchen beginnen immer häufiger auch in ChatGPT, Perplexity und Google AI Mode statt ausschließlich auf der Suchergebnisseite. Du machst diese Marken in klassischer Suche und in generativen Systemen sichtbar. Der Hebel dafür ist Content: Sichtbarkeit entsteht heute über Inhalte, die Suchintention treffen und zitierfähig sind, nicht über Keyword-Dichte. Du gibst die inhaltliche Richtung vor und sorgst dafür, dass die Sichtbarkeit belegbar ist, nicht behauptet.

  • Strategie über die gesamte Suchlandschaft: Du entwickelst Search- und Content-Strategien, die klassisches SEO und GEO/AI Search zusammenführen, statt sie als zwei Projekte zu behandeln. Du priorisierst nach Impact, nicht nach Vollständigkeit.
  • Technisches SEO in der Tiefe: Crawling, Indexierung, Core Web Vitals, JS-Rendering, Logfile-Analyse, internes Verlinkungs- und Informationsdesign. Du begleitest Relaunches und Migrationen so, dass danach nicht die Sichtbarkeit fehlt.
  • Content-Strategie und Entitätsarchitektur: Du entwickelst Themen-, Content- und Entitätsarchitekturen entlang der B2B Buying Journey von Awareness-Content für die frühe Recherche bis zu Deep-Content, aus dem LLMs zitieren. Du entscheidest, welche Themen besetzt werden, welche Formate es braucht und was bestehender Content leisten muss.
  • Content steuern, nicht schreiben: Du briefst unser Content-Team und die Fachexpert:innen unserer Kunden, reviewst gegen Suchintention und Zitierfähigkeit und entscheidest, was publiziert wird. Du baust Content-Audits, findest Kannibalisierung und Substanzlücken und leitest daraus einen Redaktionsplan ab, der auch in sechs Monaten noch trägt. Die Texte schreiben andere. Die Richtung gibst du.
  • AI Visibility aufbauen: Du arbeitest an konsistenter Entitätsdarstellung (strukturierte Daten, sameAs, Wikidata, Branchenverzeichnisse), an zitierfähigen Inhalten und an Präsenz in den Quellen, aus denen LLMs tatsächlich zitieren.
  • AI Visibility messbar machen: Prompt-Set-basierter Share of Voice über ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot und Google AI Mode – inklusive Auswertung von GPTBot-, OAI-SearchBot- und PerplexityBot-Zugriffen in den Logfiles. Referral-Traffic aus generativen Quellen trennst du so weit, wie die Datenlage es zulässt, und dokumentierst die Grenzen der Messung offen.
  • Audits mit Konsequenz: Du führst SEO- und GEO-Audits durch, analysierst Wettbewerb und Suchintentionen und leitest daraus priorisierte Maßnahmen ab, die jemand am Montag anfangen kann.
  • Verantwortung im Retainer: Du steuerst mehrere Kundenaccounts parallel, arbeitest in vereinbarten Stundenbudgets, führst die monatlichen Reporting-Calls und Quarterly Reviews und flaggst Scope-Themen früh statt spät.
  • Beratung auf Augenhöhe: Du präsentierst auf Management-Level, bist Sparringspartner:in für Marketing- und Digital-Verantwortliche und sagst auch die unbequeme Wahrheit, wenn die Lieblings-KPI nichts über das Geschäft aussagt.
  • Neugeschäft mitgestalten: Du unterstützt bei Pitches und Angeboten, schätzt Aufwände realistisch ein und bringst dein Fachthema in Kundengespräche ein, bevor das Projekt startet.
  • AI-native im eigenen Handwerk: Du nutzt LLMs und Automatisierung für Analyse, Content-Optimierung und Reporting – und weißt, wo AI-Output eine fachliche Prüfung braucht.
  • Wissen weitergeben: Du coachst Kolleg:innen und Kunden, arbeitest eng mit Content, Performance und mit deinem Analytics-Pendant zusammen und dokumentierst so, dass Setups auch nach einer Übergabe noch tragen.

Your mission

At Wandelbots, we are transforming the way people interact with robots. We are building the robotics platform that combines traditional manufacturing with modern software engineering - enabling developers to build robotics applications using modern software engineering principles on top of a reliable robotics core. Cameras are becoming a core part of this platform. From vision-guided robotics to AI-driven applications, the ability to manipulate the physical world depends on sensing the physical world first.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build the foundation for integrating cameras into our cloud-native platform. Instead of developing one-off integrations, you will design and implement a scalable integration framework that enables both Wandelbots engineers and camera manufacturers to integrate new devices with minimal effort.

Together with other Wandelbots engineers, you will define the architecture, build the first production-ready camera drivers yourself, and create the SDK and interfaces that make future integrations repeatable. Working closely with infrastructure & robotics engineers, product teams, and hardware partners, you will shape how vision devices become a substantial part of the Wandelbots ecosystem. The camera integration framework will become a component of the Wandelbots platform, running inside our Kubernetes infrastructure alongside the rest of our robotics stack.


Your profile

This role sits at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, backend engineering, and industrial vision. We don't expect anyone to be an expert in every area. Instead, we're looking for someone with a strong engineering foundation, who has previously designed APIs and has deep expertise in at least one of the following domains:
Industrial Vision & Camera Integration: You have integrated industrial cameras into production systems and understand how they are used in automation projects.
Camera Development: You have worked for a camera manufacturer or built camera software, SDKs, or device interfaces.
Cloud-native Hardware Platforms: You have experience building Kubernetes-based systems that discover, manage, and control hardware devices, including custom resources and Kubernetes controllers.

Further required Skills:
Several years of experience building backend systems (e.g. Python, Go)
API design and versioning
Comfortable developing containerized software and familiar with Kubernetes-based deployments.
Ability to take ownership of architecture, make technical decisions, and drive projects from concept to production

Awesome if you have:

Strong experience extending Kubernetes using Custom Resources, Operators, or Controllers.
Experience with Kubernetes networking for hardware and network-attached devices.
Experience integrating vendor SDKs behind a common abstraction layer.
Experience with Linux device management and exposing hardware into containers
Experience with industrial cameras, media pipelines, or camera protocols
Understanding of computer vision concepts such as calibration, depth imaging, and point clouds.
Experience with video streaming and media handling.
Background in robotics or industrial automation.

What we care about:

We are looking for an engineer who enjoys building platforms rather than one-off integrations. You should be comfortable navigating ambiguity, making architectural decisions, and creating systems that others can successfully build upon.
This is an opportunity to build the foundation for every camera integration at Wandelbots. You won't just implement the first integrations - you'll define the architecture, SDK, and developer experience that camera manufacturers, partners, and internal teams will use for years to come.


Why us?

Make an impact!
Work on an innovative, deep tech product that adds value to the robotics world and to society! Become a crucial part of something new, big and exciting where you can truly make an impact!

Our teams inspire!
Cross-functional communication is key. You'll get to know many of your 100+ colleagues. Collaborate with great people on our international teams who value knowledge sharing and unique ways of doing things!

And there is even more!
Enjoy our free lunch, snacks and drinks, team events, 30 days of annual vacation + additional rest during Christmas season until New Year. If your child gets sick, we assure that a 100% of your usual earnings will be paid while you take care of your little one.

About Motorway

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

👋 Hi, I’m Manuele Maggi, Engineering Manager at Motorway. I’m looking for an Android Engineer to join our Mobile Engineering group and help us build a best-in-class experience for our Sellers.

This is a great opportunity to join a talented and supportive team, working alongside engineers, product managers and designers to fundamentally change the way people sell their car. You’ll contribute to meaningful features used by customers across the UK, develop your technical skills and explore the latest tools and technologies—with AI increasingly embedded in how we build and work.


About the role

Day-to-day, you’ll be:
